description: This file is a shell script used for setting up, configuring, and managing a Docker-based environment for the OpenClaw project. It handles environment detection, validations, building or pulling Docker images, permissions fixing, running setup commands, managing sandbox configurations, and starting the gateway service.

methods.name: fail
methods.description: Outputs an error message to stderr and exits the script.

methods.name: require_cmd
methods.description: Checks if a command is available in the system; exits if not.

methods.name: run_docker_build
methods.description: Builds a Docker image with BuildKit enabled.

methods.name: is_truthy_value
methods.description: Determines if the input value is a truthy value (e.g., 1, true, yes, on).

methods.name: read_config_gateway_token
methods.description: Reads the gateway token from a configuration JSON file using Python or Node.js, if available.

methods.name: read_env_gateway_token
methods.description: Reads the gateway token from an environment variables file.

methods.name: ensure_control_ui_allowed_origins
methods.description: Configures the control UI allowed origins if not already set.

methods.name: sync_gateway_mode_and_bind
methods.description: Sets the gateway mode and bind configuration to local.

methods.name: run_prestart_gateway
methods.description: Runs a command in a temporary Docker container targeting the Gateway service.

methods.name: run_prestart_cli
methods.description: Runs CLI commands in a container with the Gateway as entry point.

methods.name: run_runtime_cli
methods.description: Runs CLI commands with options for scope and dependencies.

methods.name: contains_disallowed_chars
methods.description: Checks if a string contains disallowed control characters.

methods.name: is_valid_timezone
methods.description: Checks if a timezone string is valid based on presence in /usr/share/zoneinfo.

methods.name: validate_mount_path_value
methods.description: Validates a mount path value for correctness and safety.

methods.name: validate_named_volume
methods.description: Validates a volume name against a regex pattern.

methods.name: write_extra_compose
methods.description: Generates an extra Docker Compose YAML overlay file with specified mounts and volumes.

methods.name: upsert_env
methods.description: Updates or creates environment variable entries in a file.
